title: HoloStations
description: Craft, cook & unenchant in 3D instead of GUIs
body:
# Holo Stations 🔨

Inspired by [Dynamic Crafting by Youly](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dynamic-crafting), Holo Stations adds visual workstations for the **furnace, smoker, crafting table & the grindstone**

![All holo stations in the plugin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2bfb0ad5b10f5d977cdc1f3a9bcaa0b83ab7e417.png)

This plugin is designed to work on Folia (specially for the server I'm working on: [Valthorne](https://modrinth.com/server/valthorne)) and Paper from 1.21.9 (as the sprites were introduced in that ver.)

## Controls
- Right Click an empty slot to add an item (they can be stackable)
- Sneak + Right Click an empty slot to add the whole item stack to the slot.
- Sneak + Right Click an non-empty slot to swap its content with your selected item stack.
- Attack an non-empty slot to drop one item from it.
- Sneak + Attack an non-empty slot to drop all its content.
- Attack a result slot to make it spin & spin!
- Right Click the spinning item to pick it up.

> Be aware that the crafting table has its **own orientation**, marked with an arrow physically.
